# E14 build plan

Status: reviewable planning packet, blocked for implementation release by the shared contracts below. No implementation or acceptance evidence is claimed.

## Inputs and ownership

There is no `docs/tdd/E14.md`, `docs/requests/E14.md` or `docs/tdd/reviews/E14.*` in this checkout. The authority is `docs/product/tdd/E14.md:9`, its three work packages at lines 17 to 27, SYSTEM and Part A. No design is created or amended.

At inspection, `hub/`, `ui/`, `eval/`, `workers/forecast/`, `contracts/api/` and the non-pharmacy runtime configuration do not exist. Existing `contracts/pharmacy/`, `config/pharmacy/` and the root Python project belong to the engine team. Do not import or extend its forecast implementation for E14.

SYSTEM substitutes for the absent section 13: `crew_health.trends` and `workers/forecast/` are expressly E14's (`docs/SYSTEM.md:130`); module tests, feature directories and epic scenario directories follow `docs/SYSTEM.md:1625`. The task allocation instantiates those directory conventions. All other designs' section 13 inventories and all available `docs/build/*/tasks.json` were checked for overlap. E03 owns `config/indicator-catalog.json`, `config/ui-copy.json`, How you are and its common chart components (`docs/tdd/E03.md:899`). E23 owns mission, sensors, habitat adapters and Habitat; E15 owns Records; E12 owns tool handlers; E20 owns process supervision, images and packaging; E21 owns the runner and shared demo fixture. None is assigned to an E14 coder.

## Build order and connections

1. Coordinator settles and propagates R1 to R5 below before releasing the affected code. E01 supplies the real kernel, generated effective contracts, composition root, toolchain and bounded `kernel.testing` fakes. Names alone are insufficient interfaces.
2. T1 builds the hub's deterministic comparisons and internal forecast orchestration. T2 builds the isolated forecast worker. They can run in parallel only after the same worker boundary is frozen. T1 uses that agreed protocol with E01 fakes for component tests while T2 is absent. Neither coder edits the other's files.
3. T3 consumes both implementations, adds the experimental feature and exercises real HTTP and browser paths. E03 and E15 make their own mounting changes under R4. E21 integrates E14 evidence under R5. Missing scenario providers block acceptance, even where they are optional at runtime.

Hard runtime dependencies are E01 and E05; E08 is optional (`docs/SYSTEM.md:2365`). E03/E02, E23/E24 and E15 are real integration prerequisites for the scenarios that exercise their views, authorization, warnings and episode exclusions. They do not become hard dependencies for an unrelated baseline calculation. Unbuilt providers are used only through agreed application protocols with the kernel fakes in component tests (`docs/SYSTEM.md:2390`). Production never substitutes a fake, synthetic history or an empty success.

## Design decisions

**Seams.** Use SYSTEM 5.1 to 5.12 verbatim for identities, time, quantities, errors, release pins, UOW, events, command identity, audit, scheduling, tasks, settings and registration. Cross-module imports stop at application ports (SYSTEM 6.4). `IndicatorSummaryPort` belongs to E14 but has no published signature (`docs/tdd/E03.md:116`); R1 is a release prerequisite. E14 consumes records through E01, episode exclusions through E15, and habitat facts through E23. It never reads their tables or implements sensor aggregation, camera selection, sleep scoring or warning rules. No E14 table name, forecast HTTP operation, worker inference payload or forecast event is currently specified; none is invented here. R3 must publish the missing contract before those parts are built.

**Comparisons.** Preserve subject, mission, origin, activity/posture, gravity, device, method and operator context; unknown comparability stays unavailable. Exclude the current reading and unresolved episode periods under a pinned, versioned policy (`docs/product/PRD.md:578`). Use the catalog's `median` or `mean`, `window_days` and `min_samples`, retaining included IDs and exclusions (`docs/product/api/schemas/config-indicator-catalog.schema.json:40`, `docs/product/CONTRACTS.md:36`). R2 settles policy fields and interval boundaries; no coder guesses a clinical policy. Keep raw sources and conflicts, never average disagreement away. A person's sleep correction takes precedence over their confirmed band estimate with both lineages retained (`docs/tdd/E03.md:547`). Missing E08 leaves accepted manual/self-report inputs usable.

**Time.** Normalize using SYSTEM 5.2 with one snapshot and retain original times and correction provenance. Compare by observation time; input arrival cannot rejuvenate it. Mission bins and labels use SYSTEM 5.3, including retained clock versions and dataset clocks. D14's advancing replay receive reference controls only replay freshness, never subject exposure or personal cohort membership. No resampling or gap imputation in the first implementation: only a policy-qualified regular contiguous history can reach Chronos. Other histories retain gaps and the deterministic view; R2/R3 must define qualification without losing E14-03 acceptance. Forecast horizon timestamps are absolute instants; task lease, timeout and retry durations are elapsed deadlines under SYSTEM 5.10. Clock correction never reuses a completed task generation or lets an old result replace a newer input snapshot.

**Forecast isolation.** Chronos is an experimental second view under Records (`docs/product/PRD.md:431`), separate from usual values, clinical references and warning limits. Internal durable tasks use `public_kind=None`, never a new public Job kind (D17; SYSTEM 5.10.1). Freeze input IDs/revisions, release, model artifact and transformations. Execute outside write transactions; apply only a live matching generation under current grants. Forecast code has no warning mutation authority. E20 supplies resource admission and pauses/unloads forecasting around interactive inference; no local second scheduler or resource arbiter. Missing weights, worker, resource permit or eligible history leaves a labeled absent forecast and a working deterministic baseline.

**Failure cases and backups.** Primary trend: qualified historical records; independent backup: authorized source readings/manual entry without a comparison; fail safe: unavailable or insufficient, never normal. Primary forecast: worker; dissimilar backup: deterministic baseline; fail safe: absent experimental view. Primary environment context: E23 series; backup: separately labeled manual habitat input through E23; fail safe: unknown, never inferred exposure. T3 removes each primary. Test crash at task/input/result/commit/ack boundaries, retries and duplicate commands, concurrent correction/revocation, clock jumps and mission boundaries, disk full, missing/corrupt configuration and model artifacts, partial/implausible/disagreeing readings, optional parts absent, long outages and stale backlog, incapacitated/absent crew and cross-crew privacy. Storage, I/O and integrity errors propagate; they cannot become an optional-worker fallback. No E14 ground queue exists, and E14 never reads GroundLink (SYSTEM 6.4).

**Bounds.** Use SYSTEM 5.11 `storage.max_rows`, `tasks.*` and `workers.<name>.*`. R3 must freeze additional E14 history/window/output descriptors, explicit finite maxima and the resource-admission binding before startup. Clinical cohort windows and model settings are sourced release content; operational caps belong to registered hub settings. Overflow is explicit unavailable/error, never silently truncated complete history. No heavy model loads in a request or module import.

## End to end evidence

T3 owns all rows below. Each uses HTTP through the normal `create_app(settings)` composition root and real temporary SQLite, or Playwright against that running hub. No mocked in-hub services, dependency overrides or direct database seeding. Use E21's agreed explicit demo profile and seed interface. External parts may be absent or use documented adapter fakes; positive Chronos evidence must also execute the actual pinned offline model. Every row is required; zero tests, skips, xfails and unavailable-only implementations cannot pass it.

| Proof | Trace and observable result |
|---|---|
| Context-matched usual and honest gaps | E14-01, R11/R12; V07/V14/V31. HTTP-created accepted history, current reading excluded, rest separated from exercise, gravity/device/method/operator/cohort changes separated, versioned episode periods excluded, supersession respected, unknown/declined and missing history never zero, disagreement and lineage retained. Real How you are shows insufficient and trend gaps; corrected sleep and band estimate stay distinct (D02). |
| Identity isolation | R11/R12; V09/V47, D09. After the LIVE demo-operator capture through real E05/acquisition boundaries, Mara's SIM included IDs, sample count, usual, streak and crew goal are unchanged; source selection and disagreement remain attributable. E06/E03/E22 are needed for the full D09 clause. |
| Historical environment separation | E14-02, R12/R26; V10/V72, D01/D16. Run the 2014 replay beside a LIVE concern. Preserve original date and replay note, show no personal exposure or supporting observation. Inspect warning/routine causation through real E23/E24/E25. Playwright proves no CO2 measurement dot. After a confirmed environment switch, old station readings never appear current at the destination (D18; E23 owns the switch and its broader scenario). |
| Forecast versus rule | E14-03, R12; V32. Produce a real experimental expected-range forecast while a deterministic rule is concerning. Warning and urgency remain raised with original evidence; worker absence, crash, cancellation and late success cannot clear or lower either. Baseline remains accessible. No forecast evidence substitutes for a missing instrument. |
| Temporal evaluation | E14-03, R12/R26. Run the actual pinned Chronos artifact on forward holdouts and the same eligible horizons through persistence and rolling baselines. Report history length, missingness, horizon, interval coverage, denominators, errors and failures. Changing only future held-out values cannot change development transformations or forecasts. Report measured numerical/model evidence separately from disease detection or clinical validation (`docs/product/VALIDATION.md:233`). |
| Source privacy and durability | AGENTS 1.6/1.7, SYSTEM 5.7/5.8/8.3; V25/V26/V30/V35. Current object/field denial, revocation during execute and sign-out remove access and publication, including logs/tasks/client persistence. Crash/retry and duplicate submissions retain one result identity; input corrections mark/recompute against the proper snapshot. Disk/audit failure never acknowledges acceptance. |
| All optional parts absent | AGENTS 1.3/1.5; V69/V70. A real mission day with model, forecast, devices and ground absent keeps baseline/manual records, routine misses, help and rule/sensor warnings usable. Quiet/restarted/looped replay stays honestly stale and cannot clear a LIVE warning. Test source-reading and manual habitat backups, including an incapacitated subject without assumed chart consent. Broader safety providers must be present. |
| Configuration and presentation | AGENTS 1.1; V75. A sourced scratch catalog label/window edit changes served content/calculation with no code change; invalid release retains last good. Pins and active warnings survive activation/removal. Compare the UI's usual, reference and experimental forecast as distinct labeled objects, with origin, units, times, gaps and visible pressure basis. E03/E23 own the broader V75 threshold/step/environment clauses. |

E14 contributes the listed clauses to shared scenarios; E21 remains responsible for complete cross-epic verdicts. D04's broader body rendering, D09's acquisition and participation, and D16's warning/routine behavior are not reimplemented here. R26 is evidenced by the real optional worker plus unavailable fallback, not by a new manifest maintained by E14.

## Verification and completion

The commands in `tasks.json` use SYSTEM 6's uv projects and pnpm workspace. They are required implementation gates, not results obtained in this planning checkout. E01/E03/E20 must first supply their referenced projects and command contracts under R5; do not substitute the root pharmacy configuration. Worker-local import rules must cover the real worker package and forbid all hub implementation imports. Generated hub import rules must discover trends. Full acceptance requires the E01 coverage/trace gate to cover E14, every proof row above, resolved independent review and green CI. A safe disabled feature does not complete an acceptance criterion.

Planning checks passed for JSON shape, task DAG, existing read paths, disjoint ownership against the other available task files, numeric citation targets and writing rules. No git or product-code command was used. Product gates were not run because their projects are absent. The final coder reruns the full hub suite after each bug fix, as AGENTS requires. Runtime and CI evidence remains planned.
